packages.label: נֶפֶשׁ וְתוֹרָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the holy divine soul (neshamah/nefesh) and its expressions in the world. נפש, the soul, is identified as a bechina of: אדם (the human being), תורה (Torah), אור (light), זכרון (memory), חיים (life), חכמה (wisdom), חכמות התורה (Torah wisdom), צורה (form/form of the human). These are not cause-and-effect relationships — they are all different names for the same essential quality: the divine, intellectual, luminous, life-giving principle in creation. The cluster extends naturally to: (a) צדקה דארץ ישראל — which the Torah explicitly equates with נפש ('tzedakat Eretz-Yisrael, bechina nefesh'); (b) חרב לה' — which is a bechina of הבל שאין בו חטא, which is itself a bechina of נפש; (c) the entire sub-cluster of הבל שאין בו חטא / אוירא דארץ ישראל / הבל פיהם של תינוקות / תינוקות / כרובים — all expressions of the pure, sinless breath of holiness, which is equated with soul-light. The merged Component 2 (צדקה / תענית / עולם הבא) is joined here because: the Torah explicitly states 'צדקה ותענית הם בחינה אחת' and 'צדקה רמז לאור' — sharing the essential nature of the light/soul domain. They are the same spiritual coin: the suppression of the body that allows the soul's light to prevail.

merge_notes.reason: Raw Component 2 (3 nodes) — merged into Package 1 (Soul/Torah) on the basis of shared nature, not cause-effect. The Torah explicitly equates צדקה and תענית as a single bechina: 'צדקה ותענית הם בחינה אחת, כי אגרא דתעניתא צדקתא.' Furthermore, the Torah states 'צדקה רמז לאור' — charity is a symbol/bechina of אור (light), which is already in Package 1 via נפש—אור. תענית = עולם הבא (via the manna-metaphor: the closed mem = the world to come where there is no eating). All three share the essential nature of the holy, light-giving, soul-elevating domain. They do NOT belong in Package 2 (body/evil) even though fasting suppresses the body, because their intrinsic nature is positive and holy — the suppression is not their essence, their alignment with light is.

packages.label: גּוּף וְחֹשֶׁךְ
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the material body, physicality, and the opposing force against the divine soul. גוף (the body) is the hub: it is a bechina of בהמה (the animal), חמר (matter/clay), חשך (darkness), מיתה (death), סכלות (folly), שכחה (forgetting), and חכמות חיצוניות (external/foreign wisdoms). These are not different names for different things — they are all the same essential quality: the material-physical dimension of existence that opposes light, wisdom, memory, and life. The Torah states this explicitly in section ב: 'גוף ונפש הם בחינת אדם ובהמה, חמר וצורה, חכמה וסכלות, בחינת אור וחשך... בחינות שכחה וזכרון.' Each member of this cluster is a face of the same anti-divine, death-oriented, forgetting quality.

packages.label: מַנְצְפַּ"ךְ וְרִי"ו דִּין
packages.label_en: The Five Final Letters and the Din-Number
packages.reason: The three nodes share the essential nature of the five strict judgments (dinim) as embodied in the blood-letters. מנצפך (the five final letters of the Hebrew alphabet) = ורידים (veins/blood vessels) = רי"ו דין (the numerical value 216, associated with strict judgment/gevurot). All three are bechina expressions of the same underlying reality: the five blood-types in the body correspond to the five final letters, which numerically encode the force of strict din. The Torah text states: 'מנצפך הוא בחינת ורידים, בחינת ריו דין.' This is a dimension of strict judgment that — in the teaching's positive direction — is sweetened by the holy shochet to become Adonai (speech/Shekhinah). The polarity is marked evil because ריו דין represents unmitigated strict judgment; however, this component is the raw material that can be sweetened — it is the evil/judgment side that the teaching seeks to transform.

packages.label: דִּבּוּר וּשְׁכִינָה
packages.reason: The three nodes share the essential nature of the divine receptive speech — the Shekhinah as the mouth of creation. דבור (speech) is a bechina of שכינה (the divine Presence) because 'מלכות — פה' (the Shekhinah is the mouth of divinity). דבור is also a bechina of חרב פיפיות (the double-edged sword) because speech is the instrument of divine word-as-sword: 'ורוממות אל בגרונם וחרב פיפיות.' All three — holy speech, the Shekhinah, and the sword-of-the-mouth — are the same essential reality: the divine receptive channel through which souls ascend as mayin nukvin and through which sustenance flows to Israel. This package is the good mirror of Package 3: Package 3 (מנצפך/ורידים/ריו דין) is the raw din-blood that needs to be sweetened, and Package 4 (דבור/שכינה) is what it becomes when sweetened — 'כי מריו נעשה צורת א, ונעשה אדני' — the din is transformed into Adonai = speech = Shekhinah.
